description: Marseille_Parcours culturels_5 de Belsunce à la gare Saint Charles is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ville de Marseille. Ce jeu de données propose le tracé du parcours 5 de Belsunce à la gare Saint Charles contenant les informations culturelles relatives aux bâtiments et monuments historiques ainsi que leur géolocalisation. Coverage: Ville de Marseille. The portal shows the English title as "Marseille__Cultural Routes5 from Belsunce to Saint Charles Station" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ville de Marseille. Its keywords include monument-historique, activite-touristique, culture, parcours, balade. The listing shows 1 download or service links in GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
